column1: # Adverbial-use exclusion lexicon for haal extraction — DICTIONARY FORMS.
# Each entry is the dictionary form (lemma) of a word whose
# indefinite-accusative use with tanwin fath functions as a manner or
# domain adverbial rather than a circumstantial haal: in running text
# these words appear as e.g. رسمياً 'officially', سياسياً 'politically',
# تماماً 'completely'. Extraction looks up the candidate token's
# dictionary form in this list and excludes matches.
# One entry per line; '#' lines are comments. Matching is applied after
# diacritic and alef-variant normalization, so diacritization here is
# irrelevant. Curated to build the paper's dataset; extend or replace
